in_hebrew.name: Nap
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Nap הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek mythology, Nap represents a god of the earth and agriculture. The name is derived from the Greek word 'nape,' meaning 'rest' or 'relaxation.' In the Bible, Nap is also the name of a man in the Old Testament who lived 910 years.

in_greek.name: Νάπτης
in_greek.long_meaning: derived from the Greek word napo (νάπω), meaning to nap or rest
